layout_sources: https://github.com/firefly-iii/import-configurations/blob/main/us/citi/default.json (5 columns: ignore, date, description, debit, credit; m/d/Y)
https://lists.gnucash.org/pipermail/gnucash-user/2019-March/083408.html (a Citi file with a member name column after Credit)
notes: Status,Date,Description,Debit,Credit (cards with more than one card member add Member Name). Purchases under Debit as positive figures; payments and refunds under Credit with a minus sign (as most reports say; one guide says unsigned). Status "Cleared" (a "Pending" row can appear). Newest first, MM/DD/YYYY, no thousands separator. Older exports quoted every field; the description quoted and LF line ends are assumed. No balance in the file.
